includeMarkdown.description: When true, also return the brief's rendered Markdown alongside the parsed record. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the brief; also used to build the stored filename.

targetAgent.description: Agent or role this brief is written for; slugified into the filename and matched exactly by the list_briefs targetAgent filter.

goal.description: What the target agent should accomplish; rendered as the brief's goal section.

scope.description: Boundaries of the work: in-scope topics, in-scope files, and an optional timeframe.

topics.description: In-scope subject areas; rendered as the brief's relevant-background list.

files.description: Project-relative paths in scope; each must resolve inside the project root or the call is rejected.

timeframe.description: Optional free-text period the brief covers, in the user's own wording.

exclusions.description: Out-of-scope items and known pitfalls; rendered as the brief's Known Pitfalls list.

relevantFiles.description: Source links worth reading (kind: file, url, commit, issue, record, command, or repo); file links must resolve inside the project root.

designBasis.description: The reasoning and constraints the current design rests on, so the target agent does not relitigate settled ground.

priorReasoningSummary.description: Condensed record of decisions already made and why, carried forward instead of raw conversation.

constraints.description: Hard limits the target agent must respect; accepted for compatibility but not written into the record by the MCP server — put binding limits in designBasis or exclusions.

recommendedNextSteps.description: Concrete next actions; rendered as the brief's Recommended Next Steps list.

tags.description: Lowercase slug tags (a-z, 0-9, hyphen) for later filtering; must be unique.

targetAgent.description: Return only briefs whose targetAgent equals this value exactly.

tags.description: Return only briefs carrying every tag listed; tags are slug-matched.

status.description: Return only briefs in this lifecycle state: draft, active, or archived.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp intended to bound results by creation time; accepted but not applied by the MCP server, which returns all matching briefs.

limit.description: Maximum briefs to return (1-50). Results are newest-first, so a limit keeps the most recent; unset returns every match.

id.description: Record ID or stored filename stem of the brief; must match exactly one brief or the call fails.

includeMarkdown.description: When true, also return the brief's rendered Markdown alongside the parsed record. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the packet; also used to build the stored filename.

purpose.description: 'handoff' (default) for work passed to someone else; 'seed' for private carried-forward context, which is always written to the private outbox.

sensitivity.description: 'project' (default) writes to .notch/outbox/; 'private' writes to .notch/private/outbox/ and hides the packet from listings unless the server runs with --include-private. Defaults to 'private' when purpose is 'seed'.

toAgent.description: Intended recipient agent; routing intent recorded on the packet, not a delivery mechanism. A handoff packet needs at least one of toAgent, toPerson, or toRepo.

toPerson.description: Intended recipient person; routing intent recorded on the packet. Satisfies the handoff recipient requirement.

toRepo.description: Intended recipient repository; routing intent recorded on the packet. Satisfies the handoff recipient requirement.

task.description: One-line statement of the task, rendered into the packet's included-context section.

summary.description: The working state being handed off — what is done, decided, and blocked. A summary over 5000 characters with no source links or included records returns a NOTCH_SUMMARY_LARGE warning.

nextSteps.description: What the receiving agent should do next; rendered as its own packet section.

files.description: Project-relative file paths copied into the packet as artifacts, optionally suffixed with a purpose ('docs/plan.md:source'). Valid purposes are asset, source, reference, and output, plus common aliases such as logo, image, or screenshot.

refs.description: Project-relative paths to reference without copying; each is recorded as a file source link.

include.description: Existing 3Notch brief records to list as included context on the packet.

id.description: Record ID of the included brief.

recordType.description: Kind of included record: the repo's default 'project_brief' or a targeted 'brief'.

title.description: Title of the included record, shown in the packet's included-context list.

path.description: Path of the included record inside the .notch store.

summary.description: Optional note on why the record is included.

sourceLinks.description: Context links to record (kind: file, url, commit, issue, record, command, or repo); file links must resolve inside the project root and may not point inside the .notch store.

importNotes.description: Guidance for whoever imports the packet; the body shows 'Review before use.' when omitted.

outputPath.description: Project-relative path to write an extra copy of the packet Markdown to, in addition to the store copy.

supersedes.description: Record ID this packet replaces; check_store reports the edge as broken if the referenced record is not in the store.

tags.description: Lowercase slug tags (a-z, 0-9, hyphen) for later filtering; must be unique.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the importer in the audit log; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

packetPath.description: Absolute path to a packet Markdown file or an unpacked packet folder; relative paths and symlinks are refused.

asReviewed.description: When true, record the imported packet as reviewed instead of unreviewed. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

title.description: Short title for the mark; defaults to the first non-empty line of summary, truncated to 80 characters.

summary.description: The note being captured; stored verbatim as the mark's summary.

supersedes.description: Record ID this mark replaces; check_store reports the edge as broken if the referenced record is not in the store.

sourceLinks.description: Context links to attach (kind: file, url, commit, issue, record, command, or repo); file links must resolve inside the project root.

tags.description: Lowercase slug tags (a-z, 0-9, hyphen) for later filtering; must be unique.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

parentId.description: Record ID of the packet being replied to; must match exactly one record in the store, private records included.

replyType.description: What kind of response this is; recorded on the reply and used by readers to triage it.

summary.description: The reply itself — the question, correction, or confirmation being sent back.

title.description: Short title for the reply; defaults to 'Reply to <parent title>'.

toAgent.description: Override the recipient agent; by default the reply inherits the parent packet's recipient.

toPerson.description: Override the recipient person; by default the reply inherits the parent packet's recipient.

toRepo.description: Override the recipient repository; when replying to a received packet this defaults to the parent's origin project.

private.description: When true, write the reply into the private inbox instead of the outbox. Default false; replies to private or seed parents are private regardless.

nextSteps.description: What the recipient should do next; rendered as its own section of the reply.

files.description: Project-relative file paths copied into the reply as artifacts, optionally suffixed with a purpose ('diff.patch:source'). Valid purposes are asset, source, reference, and output, plus common aliases.

refs.description: Project-relative paths to reference without copying; each is recorded as a file source link.

sourceLinks.description: Context links to record (kind: file, url, commit, issue, record, command, or repo); file links must resolve inside the project root.

tags.description: Lowercase slug tags (a-z, 0-9, hyphen) for later filtering; must be unique.

direction.description: 'inbox' for packets received here, 'outbox' for packets created here, 'both' (default).

includePrivate.description: Request private records too. Honoured only when the server was started with --include-private; otherwise results stay public and a NOTCH_PRIVATE_HIDDEN warning is returned. Default false.

purpose.description: Return only handoff packets or only seed packets.

tags.description: Return only packets carrying every tag listed; tags are slug-matched.

to.description: Recipient filter; accepted but not applied by the MCP server — filter the returned recipient fields yourself.

fromProject.description: Origin-project filter; accepted but not applied by the MCP server — filter the returned origin fields yourself.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp intended to bound results by creation time; accepted but not applied by the MCP server.

limit.description: Maximum packets to return (1-50, default 50). Results are newest-first, so a limit keeps the most recent.

id.description: Packet record ID or stored filename stem; must match exactly one packet or the call fails.

direction.description: Restrict the lookup to received packets, packets created here, or both (default).

includePrivate.description: Include private packets in the lookup. Honoured only when the server was started with --include-private. Default false.

includeMarkdown.description: When true, also return the packet's rendered Markdown alongside the parsed record. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the seed packet; also used to build the stored filename.

sourceStorePath.description: Path of the store the context came from; accepted but not recorded by the MCP server — name the source in summary instead.

summary.description: The private context being carried forward; stored as the packet summary and repeated in the packet's User Preferences section.

userPreferences.description: Preferences to carry forward; accepted but not recorded by the MCP server — fold them into summary.

workflowConventions.description: Working conventions to carry forward; accepted but not recorded by the MCP server — fold them into summary.

lessons.description: Lessons from prior work to carry forward; accepted but not recorded by the MCP server — fold them into summary.

prompts.description: Reusable prompts to carry forward; accepted but not recorded by the MCP server — fold them into summary.

sourceLinks.description: Context links to attach (kind: file, url, commit, issue, record, command, or repo); file links must resolve inside the project root.

outputPath.description: Project-relative path to write an extra copy of the seed packet Markdown to, in addition to the store copy.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the importer in the audit log; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

packetPath.description: Absolute path to a seed packet Markdown file or unpacked packet folder; relative paths and symlinks are refused, and the packet must have purpose: seed.

asReviewed.description: When true, record the imported seed packet as reviewed instead of unreviewed. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the author of this write; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

name.description: Mailbox label for this store; it becomes the local: address senders use. A routing label chosen by the user, not an authenticated identity.

root.description: Absolute path to the shared mailbox directory both sides register; relative paths are refused.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the sender in the audit log; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

packetPath.description: Absolute path to the .notchpkt archive produced by notch packet pack; other file types and symlinks are refused.

to.description: Destination address in the form local:<name>, registered by the receiving store on the same mailbox root.

includeAll.description: When true, include pulled, acknowledged, and rejected deliveries as well as pending ones. Default false (pending only).

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier from send_packet or list_inbox, formatted 'delivery_' followed by 24 hex characters.

address.description: Registered local: address to read the delivery from, in the same mailbox root. Defaults to this store's own address; a sender passes the recipient's address to see status.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the puller in the audit log; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier from list_inbox, formatted 'delivery_' followed by 24 hex characters.

import.description: When true, import the verified packet into this store through normal validation. Default false, which verifies the delivery without writing a record.

asReviewed.description: Mark the imported packet as reviewed rather than unreviewed. Requires import=true, otherwise the call fails with NOTCH_INBOX_IMPORT_REQUIRED. Default false.

actorName.description: Name recorded as the acknowledger in the audit log; defaults to the server's configured actor, or 'mcp-client'.

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier from list_inbox or get_inbox_delivery, formatted 'delivery_' followed by 24 hex characters.

includeWarnings.description: Accepted but not applied — config validation warnings are always included in the response.

strict.description: When true, escalate warnings — missing .notch/.gitignore entries and Claude Code hook drift — to errors. Default false.

fixDerivedState.description: When true, create missing store directories, add the required .notch/.gitignore entries, and rebuild the derived index. The only mutating option here; refused when the server runs in read-only mode. Default false.
